id: \bRudy uses all the different types to battle.
en: \bRudy uses all the different types to battle.
it: \bRudy lotta usando tutti i tipi diversi.

id: \bRudy: So you think you're ready to take me on?
en: \bRudy: So you think you're ready to take me on?
it: \bRudy: Quindi pensi di essere pronto ad affrontarmi?

id: \bLet's just see if you're worthy of a badge.
en: \bLet's just see if you're worthy of a badge.
it: \bVediamo se sei degno di una medaglia.

id: \bRudy: You've earned the Spike Shell Badge.
en: \bRudy: You've earned the Spike Shell Badge.
it: \bRudy: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Conchiglia Spinosa.

id: \bTM67 contains Retaliate. It doubles in power if one of your Pokémon just fainted.
en: \bTM67 contains Retaliate. It doubles in power if one of your Pokémon just fainted.
it: \bLa MT67 contiene Nemesi. Raddoppia di potenza se uno dei tuoi Pokémon è appena andato KO.

id: \bRudy: So this was your third badge? You're almost ready to challenge Drake.
en: \bRudy: So this was your third badge? You're almost ready to challenge Drake.
it: \bRudy: Quindi questa era la tua terza medaglia? Sei quasi pronto a sfidare Drake.

id: \bI think Rudy is going to use a Water type in battle.
en: \bI think Rudy is going to use a Water type in battle.
it: \bSecondo me Rudy userà un Pokémon di tipo Acqua in lotta.

id: \bI think Rudy is going to use a Grass type in battle.
en: \bI think Rudy is going to use a Grass type in battle.
it: \bSecondo me Rudy userà un Pokémon di tipo Erba in lotta.

id: \bLet's test you against a Rock and Psychic type.
en: \bLet's test you against a Rock and Psychic type.
it: \bVediamo come te la cavi contro un tipo Roccia e uno Psico.

id: \bI think Rudy is going to use an Electric type in battle.
en: \bI think Rudy is going to use an Electric type in battle.
it: \bSecondo me Rudy userà un Pokémon di tipo Elettro in lotta.
